plan.summary: RI-3.1 Response Time Correlation engine: compute first-customer-msg to first-agent-response delta per conversation using MSSQL timestamps, join with PG wa_conversation_outcomes, bucket into 5 time ranges, and expose via POST compute + GET read endpoints. Instance-based filtering via MSSQL Chats.InstanceID.
plan.q_intent: RI Faz 3 Paket A: 3 LLM-free insight engine (3.1 Response Time Correlation + 3.3 Agent Leaderboard + 3.6 Follow-up Rescue Alerts). Paket 1 = 3.1 Response Time.
plan.interview_notes: 3 ayri paket. POST trigger + GET read pattern. Instance bazli ayirma (MSSQL join'de filter, PG outcome'lara dokunmadan). Kod + 1 tenant test (EbruModa). Join key: wa_conversation_outcomes.conversation_id = Chats.CustomerPhoneNumber.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/insights/compute/response-time returns 200, computes response times from MSSQL, writes results to wa_response_times in PostgreSQL
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: EbruModa tenant_id=5051: 1191 outcomes -> 1191 computed, 0 errors, 916ms. HTTP 200.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/ops/insights/response-time/{tenantId} returns JSON with per-bucket conversion rate correlation (bucket, conversation_count, conversion_rate)
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: GET returns 6 buckets with conversation_count, sale_count, conversion_rate, percentage fields.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EbruModa (tenant_id=5051, database=WaClientEbruModa) successful compute cycle produces stored results
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 3 MSSQL instances (5521, 6473, 5538) queried. 1191 records upserted to PG. Dedup handled cross-instance duplicates.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Response time bucket distribution has at least 2 non-zero buckets from EbruModa data
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 6 non-zero buckets: instant=280, fast=144, moderate=127, slow=54, very_slow=36, no_response=550

verification_questions.question: Does the MSSQL query correctly join Chats.CustomerPhoneNumber with PG conversation_id and handle NULL timestamps?
Is the ops-level X-Ops-Key authentication applied to both POST compute and GET read endpoints?
Does the compute service handle edge cases: empty outcomes, MSSQL connection failure, conversations with no agent response?
Are response time records upserted (not duplicated) on repeated compute calls for the same tenant?

intentional_exclusions: wa_conversation_outcomes.instance_id backfill (interview karari: insight'ta instance filter kullan)

try_catch_locations: Program.cs: POST endpoint — top-level error handler
user_facing_errors: INV-WA-020: Insight compute failed — MSSQL connection error
INV-WA-021: Insight compute failed — no classified outcomes found
INV-WA-022: Insight data not found for tenant
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All errors logged via JsonLinesLogger with request IDs. MSSQL failures throw, PG failures throw, both caught at endpoint level with ErrorResponse.
